normal.encoding: RGB = 0.5 * view-space normal + 0.5; +X right, +Y up, +Z viewer; linear data

channels.R: hand-tuned normalized height plus luminance detail
channels.G: Weighted encoded image RGB brightness; no sRGB-to-linear decoding, not measured albedo

limits: Single view; not a multi-view mesh unwrap
Photo shading and pigmentation influence estimated feather relief
Broad head/breast/wing volume is manually approximated
No calibrated anatomy or hidden-surface reconstruction
runtime: Maps are regenerated from source on load; PNGs are deterministic exports of the same arrays.
